{
  "clearExpectedBehavior": true,
  "rationale": "The report explicitly requires reset to clear old projectiles, zones and effects and restore fresh resources. Gameplay creates all three before reset and depletes health and mana without manufacturing post-reset state. The supplied trace reproduces the defect: shots remains 1 after reset. Original ResetWorld clears zones and effects and constructs fresh fighters but omits shots.Clear(). Retain the direct cleanup and resource witness below. The final enemy-health, enemy-control and clock assertions are vacuous because those values already equal their expected values immediately before that reset; ordinary projectile damage and root balance are outside this cleanup specification.",
